note: This file is a configuration-only file (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines dataset settings, preprocessing pipelines, and dataloader/evaluator configs for COCO caption tasks in MMDetection.
config_dataset_type: configure the dataset type to CocoCaptionDataset for image captioning tasks
config_test_pipeline: configure the test pipeline with LoadImageFromFile, Resize, and PackInputs steps
config_val_dataloader: configure the validation dataloader with batch size, sampler, and dataset settings
config_val_evaluator: configure the COCOCaptionMetric evaluator with ground truth annotation file path
config_backend_args: configure backend_args for file client support including S3 and petrel backends
